comparison.objective: Drive a piston through a ring compressor into a bore; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests holding a compressor flat while applying axial insertion force and preventing ring escape. Candidate tests narrow tool guidance, simultaneous latch release, and coordinated axial withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires rings to cross safely and the piston to reach its installed depth without escape or jamming. Candidate requires only the selected terminal to leave, with tang-release causality and no connector damage.
comparison.reason: Although both use bimanual force control, insertion through a compressor and selective latch-mediated extraction test meaningfully different abilities.
